untested.name: Volume-confirmed breakout
untested.reason: No volume data available in FLOW's datasets. Hypothesis: requires breakout volume ≥ 1.5× 50-day average. Status: NOT TESTED.

untested.name: Catalyst-based swing
untested.reason: No point-in-time catalyst history. Taught conceptually; use the Catalyst tracker for paper trades. Status: NOT TESTED.

untested.name: Pairs trading
untested.reason: Requires short selling (margin + permissions). Taught only; not simulated.

lab.name: Trend following
lab.explain: Hold equities when the market is above its long-term average; otherwise T-bills.
lab.stress: Fails in V-shaped crashes (1987, 2020): sells near the bottom.
lab.breakit: Every SMA length from 3 to 24 months beat buy-and-hold out-of-sample on Sharpe, and walk-forward selection also beat it. Not broken. Since 1900 it returned slightly more (11.6% vs 10.1%/yr) with far smaller drawdowns — the edge is mostly avoiding a few deep bear markets.

lab.name: Momentum (time-series)
lab.explain: Hold when trailing 12-month return beats cash.
lab.stress: Late at turning points; whipsaws in choppy years.
lab.breakit: Out-of-sample Sharpe held up; closely related to trend following (same underlying effect).

lab.name: Mean reversion
lab.explain: Buy after big down months, hold 3 months.
lab.stress: Big down months cluster in bear markets.

lab.name: Trend + calm-vol override
lab.explain: Stay invested in calm markets even below trend.
lab.breakit: Weaker than plain trend. Adding a parameter added nothing. Rejected.

lab.name: Volatility-adjusted exposure
lab.explain: Scale exposure inversely to recent volatility.
lab.stress: Vol spikes after the fall — reduces exposure late.
lab.breakit: Did not beat buy-and-hold Sharpe out-of-sample at the monthly index level. Rejected for this use.

lab.name: Value (valuation timing)
lab.explain: Hold only when CAPE is near its own history.
lab.breakit: Worst result: out of the market for long bull runs. Rejected as a timing tool.

lab.name: Value + momentum
lab.explain: In the market if EITHER trend is up OR valuation is reasonable.
lab.breakit: Better than value alone, worse than trend alone. Value added no robustness.

lab.name: Quality/relative strength rotation (stocks vs gold)
lab.explain: Hold whichever of stocks or gold has the stronger 6-month return.
lab.breakit: Every lookback beat stocks-only Sharpe 2000–2026. But this period is gold-favorable; 1971–1999 result was only similar to stocks. Partially robust.
